review_evidence: README describes Leansi as a Lean terminal-output library for styling, ANSI color fallback, layout, terminal capability detection, progress bars, boxes and trees.

A repository-wide grep across Lean sources finds no theorem, lemma, example or axiom declarations in the library; the approximately 175 common declarations are implementation datatypes, functions and instances for terminal rendering.
Example.lean is a large executable terminal demonstration and leansi.lean is an import aggregator; the source does not define an independent mathematical/specification/verified-semantics development.

source_action.content_invariant: The Lean corpus consists of terminal-document/style/layout/rendering datatypes and implementation functions plus executable demonstrations, with no theorem/lemma/example/axiom declarations establishing mathematical or semantic properties; retirement therefore removes no independent formal prior-art development.
